case.summary: Case HHG-007 was initiated for customer C09933 on card C09933-K2 following a risk score trigger of 0.87 on transaction 3514948. Graph analysis established a fraud probability of 0.98 and a verdict of fraud under the account_takeover pattern. The investigation identified a fraudulent episode comprising 3 transactions totaling $265.85 between 2016-12-02 and 2016-12-05. Based on robust multi-signal evidence, actions include recommending a card block routed through L1 and creating a case automatically.
